chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halaby, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever prays with them in the first row is with them in the first row is like the one who prays behind the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for praying in the first row of congregation?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to emphasize the immense spiritual merit of occupying the first row (al-saff al-awwal) during congregational prayer. This comparison to praying directly behind the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) underscores the continuity of prophetic tradition and the specific virtue attributed to the first row in Shia jurisprudence, linking it to the concept of following the Imam closely in both physical and spiritual alignment.
